auditMetadata.reportTitle: CodeForge Pass 1 Legal & Commercial Release Readiness Audit Report

legalP0Blockers.title: Root LICENSE File Missing from Repository Root
legalP0Blockers.remediation: Commit canonical MIT License text to repository root and add license field to packages/*/package.json upon authorization.

legalP0Blockers.title: Absence of User Data Deletion & Automated Retention (RETENTION_POLICY_UNDEFINED)
legalP0Blockers.remediation: Implement local session deletion route, cloud account deletion cascade, and automated 30-day TTL purge before commercial cloud launch.

legalP0Blockers.title: OpenRouter Standard Terms Resale Restriction (OPENROUTER_STANDARD_TERMS_COMMERCIAL_ROUTING_REVIEW_REQUIRED)
legalP0Blockers.remediation: Maintain Desktop as client-side BYOK; restrict hosted multi-tenant cloud proxying until enterprise reseller agreement is executed.

legalP0Blockers.title: Google Gemini Unpaid Services Regional Restriction in EEA, UK & Switzerland
legalP0Blockers.remediation: Deploy geo-blocking to disable Gemini Unpaid routes for users in EEA/UK/CH; mandate Paid Services keys in these jurisdictions.

legalP1Risks.title: Minimum Age & Upstream Provider Alignment
legalP1Risks.remediation: Resolve business decision on 18+ eligibility; implement age gate or onboarding confirmation.

legalP1Risks.title: FTC Green Guides Exposure for ForgeGreen Claims
legalP1Risks.remediation: Adhere strictly to docs/forgegreen.md L143; eliminate quantitative carbon reduction claims.

legalP1Risks.title: Unsandboxed Host OS Autonomous Execution Liability
legalP1Risks.remediation: Require user confirmation before Full-Auto mode; prominently present AI Output Disclaimer.

legalP1Risks.title: CodeForge Trademark Clearance Defect
legalP1Risks.remediation: Conduct comprehensive software trademark search across USPTO and international classes.

legalP1Risks.title: Third-Party Model Provider Logos in UI
legalP1Risks.remediation: Include nominative fair use disclaimers in UI Model Selector.

legalP1Risks.title: Stripe Test Mode to Live Mode Migration
legalP1Risks.remediation: Complete merchant underwriting; transition from test to live keys; activate auto-renewal terms.
